To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the call completion rate is higher when the call holding times are more variable.
the call completion probabilities are higher when the variance of the Erlang call holding time is larger and the variance of the residence time is smaller.
the variance of the distribution of call holding times has a negative effect on the call completion rate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of call holding time distribution on PCS call completion probabilities.
the impact of call holding time distributions on the PCS system performance.
the effect of the Erlang call holding time distribution on the call completion probabilities in the PCS systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the variance of the Erlang call holding time distribution should be large to achieve a high call completion probability.
a larger variance of the call residence times and a larger variance of call holding times would result in a larger call completion probability.
the variance of the Erlang call holding time has an effect on the performance of PCS channel allocation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a PCS operator should not be too concerned about the variance of the wireless call holding times as long as the variance of cell residence times is large.

, in a PCS system where the call completion probability is a concern, the variance of the user's call holding times should be as large as possible, which can be achieved by using a flat rate billing plan.
the Erlang call holding time assumption provides a conservative performance evaluation of a PCS system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the variance of the Erlang call holding time distribution should be taken into consideration when modeling future PCS systems.
the call completion rate is a function of both the variance of the channel holding times and the variance of the residence times of the cells.
the call completion performance of a PCS system can be improved by exercising flat rate billing, which reduces the variance of the wireless call holding times.
